ABOUT

A designer who thinks in flows, systems and small details.

Six-plus years in design, starting with brands and video and now focused on digital products. I bring both craft and structure to every screen.

Nakul KandalkarProduct & UI/UX Designer · Pune
LinkedInInstagram

Hi, I'm Nakul.

I'm a product and UI/UX designer with 6+ years of design experience, creating user-centred mobile apps, responsive websites and enterprise platforms. My work spans user research, wireframing, prototyping, design systems and usability testing, always grounded in how real people actually use a product.

Before product design, I worked as a freelance graphic designer and video editor from 2019 to 2025. That gave me a strong visual foundation in composition, typography and motion that I now bring into intuitive, scalable digital experiences.

At PRYM Solutions I design across agri-tech and operations platforms, from farmer-facing apps to tools for drone pilots, working closely with engineering so what ships matches what was designed.

What I bring to a product team

User research

Conversations with the people closest to users, like drone pilots who meet farmers daily, plus competitor studies.

Wireframing & prototyping

From rough wireframes to interactive Figma prototypes the team can react to.

Visual & responsive design

Six years of graphic design behind clean, trustworthy UI for web and mobile.
